name: Giver of Runes
oracle_text: {T}: Another target creature you control gains protection from colorless or from the color of your choice until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Another target creature you control gains protection from colorless or from the color of your choice until end of turn.

needs.what: a protection quality meaning "colorless" (702.16, 105.2c) that grant_protection's from_colors (and the protection static) can carry, matching any source with no colors -- e.g. from_colors: ["colorless"] -- so the ability can be a choose_mode of six grant_protection modes: colorless, W, U, B, R, G, each on objects {target: t1} where t1 is another creature you control
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_protection's from_colors takes colour letters and _matches_protection in characteristics.py tests set(types)|set(subtypes)|set(colors) of the source against the qualities; a colorless source has an empty colour set, so no quality string can ever match it. choose_color only offers the five colours (COLOR_CHOICES), and from_everything is far broader than colorless. The coloured half alone (choose_mode over five grant_protection from_colors modes) is expressible, but dropping the colorless option would be an approximation.
